mapper.insert: insert into equipment (code, name, category_id, brand, model, unit, price, stock_quantity, image, description, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{code}, #{name}, #{categoryId}, #{brand}, #{model}, #{unit}, #{price}, #{stockQuantity}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select:
select e.*, c.name as categoryName from equipment e left outer join category c on e.category_id = c.id
and e.code like concat('%', #{code}, '%')
and e.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and e.brand like concat('%', #{brand}, '%')
and e.category_id = #{categoryId}
and e.status = #{status}
order by e.create_time desc
mapper.update:
update equipment
name = #{name},
category_id = #{categoryId},
code = #{code},
brand = #{brand},
model = #{model},
unit = #{unit},
price = #{price},
stock_quantity = #{stockQuantity},
image = #{image},

update_time = #{updateTime},
update_user = #{updateUser}
where id = #{id}
